rationale: C14 is a clear reusable drafting template for the child. The directives use nearly identical language and the same operative structure: closing the same enumerated federal offices in metropolitan Washington around Christmas, excusing metropolitan and field-service employees, and preserving identical exceptions for special public reasons and conflicts with existing law. The child principally adapts the date and changes the closure and excused-duty period from one-half day before Christmas to all day after Christmas. C13 and C01 share some institutional terminology but not comparable machinery or distinctive overall language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the several executive departments, independent establishments, and other governmental agencies in the metropolitan area of the District of Columbia, including the General Accounting Office, the Government Printing Office, and the Navy Yard and Naval stations, shall be closed all day
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the several executive departments, independent establishments, and other governmental agencies in the metropolitan area of the District of Columbia, including the General Accounting Office, the Government Printing Office, and the Navy Yard and Naval Stations, shall be closed one-half day
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the distinctive enumeration and closure command, changing only the duration and holiday-relative date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all employees in the Federal service in the metropolitan area of the District of Columbia, and in the field service of the executive departments, independent establishments, and other agencies of the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all employees in the Federal service in the metropolitan area of the District of Columbia and in the field service of the executive departments, independent establishments, and other agencies of the Government
shared_material.explanation: The same categories of employees are covered in the same sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: except those who may for special public reasons be excluded from the provisions of this order by the heads of their respective departments, establishments, or agencies, or those shows absence from duty would be inconsistent with the provisions of existing law
shared_material.parent_excerpt: except those who may for special public reasons be excluded from the provisions of this order by the heads of their respective departments, establishments, or agencies, or those whose absence from duty would be inconsistent with the provisions of existing law
shared_material.explanation: The exception clause is effectively verbatim; the child's word “shows” is evidently a transcription error for “whose.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: Friday, December 26, 1952, the day following Christmas Day
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Friday, December 24, 1948, the day preceding Christmas Day
shared_material.explanation: The holiday-specific factual slot is directly adapted while the surrounding drafting remains parallel.
